table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Icode,
	Openingbalance, 
	OpeningDue,
	type,
	Postdate,
	Due,
	date,
	salesman,
	title,
	godown,
	qtyInActual,
	qtyInBonus,
	qtyIn,
	qtyOut,
	qtyOutActual,
	qtyOutBonus,
	batch,
	purprice,
	discperc,
	avgprice,
	rate,
	itemname,
	aliasname, 
	expiry,
	reference,
	price,
	discount,
	UTN,	
	HeaderNo,
	HeaderInvNo,
	Manufacturer = 
		(SELECT M.NAME FROM Manufacturer M, Item I
		WHERE I.ICode = T.ICode AND I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode),
	PackUnits
FROM
	(SELECT 
		I.Icode,
		Openingbalance=SUM(A.Qty), 
		OpeningDue=SUM(A.OpeningDue),
		type = SPACE(30),
		Postdate = :ar_stdate,
		Due = null,
		date = :ar_stdate,
		salesman = space(60),
		title = 'Opening Balance',
		godown = NULL,
		qtyInActual = 0,
		qtyInBonus = 0,
		qtyIn = 0,
		qtyOut= 0,
		qtyOutActual=0,
		qtyOutBonus=0,
		batch = space(100),
		purprice=Max(Round(i.purprice / case i.packunits when 0 then 1 else i.packunits end, 2)),
		discperc=0,
		avgprice=Max(i.avgprice),
		rate=Max(Round(i.saleprice / case i.packunits when 0 then 1 else i.packunits end, 2)),
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = i.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = i.icode),
		expiry=null,
		reference = space(20),
		price = 0,
		discount = 0,
		UTN=-1,	
		HeaderNo=NULL,
		HeaderInvNo=NULL,
		PackUnits=(Select item.packunits from item where icode = i.icode)
	FROM	
		Item I
		LEFT OUTER JOIN
		(SELECT	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
									when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
									when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
									else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0)),
			openingdue=0
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
		WHERE 
			pl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pl.postdate < :ar_stdate and 
			pd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT pd.icode, qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits), openingdue=0
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
				pl.date < :ar_stdate and 
			pd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty), openingdue=0
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			 sl.date < :ar_stdate AND sd.Due IS NULL and 
			sd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty), openingdue=0
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			sl.postdate < :ar_stdate and 
			sd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.qty), openingdue=0
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
		WHERE sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
			sl.date < :ar_stdate  and sd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.qty), openingdue=0
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
				sl.postdate < :ar_stdate and 
			sd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty), openingdue=0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
				sl.posteddate < :ar_stdate and 
			sd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.looseqty), openingdue=0
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
			sl.posteddate < :ar_stdate and sd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT d.icode, qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty), openingdue=-sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
				h.duesatisfydate < :ar_stdate and 
			d.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By d.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty  = 0, openingdue= sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			sl.date < :ar_stdate AND sd.Due IS NOT NULL and 
			sd.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT d.icode, qty = 0, openingdue=-sum(d.deletedqty)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duedeletedetail d
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
				h.duesatisfydate < :ar_stdate and 
			d.icode in (:ar_icode)
		Group By d.icode) AS A ON (i.icode = a.icode)
	WHERE i.icode in (:ar_icode) 
	GROUP BY i.icode
	UNION 
	select
		purdetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = 'PV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), purledger.purinvcode))),
		Postdate = purledger.postdate,
		Due = null,
		date = purledger.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title = Case When purcatcode = 1 or purcatcode = 2 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8  Then 
				(Select accounts.name From accounts
				Where accounts.acccode = purledger.suppcode)	
			Else 'Opening Purchase'	
			End,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = purdetail.gcode),
		qtyInActual = Case 
			When purledger.purcatcode IN (3,7,8) THEN purdetail.looseqty
			Else purdetail.looseqty + (purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits) END,
		qtyInBonus = Case 
			When purledger.purcatcode IN (3,7,8) THEN purdetail.bonusqty
			Else (purdetail.bonusqty * purdetail.packunits) END,
		qtyIn = Case 
			When purledger.purcatcode IN (3,7,8) THEN purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty
			Else purdetail.looseqty + (purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits) + (purdetail.bonusqty * purdetail.packunits) 
						END,
		qtyOut= 0,
		qtyOutActual=0,
		qtyOutBonus=0,
		batch = purdetail.batch,
		purprice=purdetail.purprice,
		discperc=purdetail.discperc,
		avgprice=purdetail.newavgprice,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = purdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = purdetail.icode),
		expiry=purdetail.expiry,
		reference = '         ',
		price = Case When purcatcode = 3 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8 Then purdetail.purprice
				Else purdetail.purprice / purdetail.packunits 
				End,
		discount = purdetail.DiscPerc,
		UTN=isnull(purdetail.purutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=PurLedger.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=PurLedger.HeaderInvNo,
		PackUnits=purdetail.packunits
	from  purledger, purdetail, users	  
	where purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and	
			purdetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			purledger.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate 	and
			purledger.Posted = 'Y' and 
			purledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION	
	select 
		issuedetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = 'IS-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), IssueHeader.issueinvcode))),
		Postdate = IssueHeader.postdate,
		Due = null,
		date = IssueHeader.date,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title = (SELECT department.name from department where department.deptcode=issueheader.deptcode),
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = issuedetail.gcode),
		qtyInActual = 0,
		qtyInBonus = 0,
		qtyIn = 0,
		qtyOut= qty,
		qtyOutActual=qty,
		qtyOutBonus=0,
		batch = Issuedetail.batch,
		purprice=Issuedetail.purchaseprice,
		discperc=0,
		avgprice=Issuedetail.avgprice,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = issuedetail.icode) ,
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = issuedetail.icode),
		expiry=Issuedetail.expiry,
		reference = ISNULL((select name from issuetype where issuetypecode = issueheader.issuetypecode), '') + CASE issueheader.issuetypecode WHEN NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END + dbo.issueheader.referenceno,
		price = issuedetail.purchaseprice,
		discount = 0,
		UTN=isnull(issuedetail.issueutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=IssueHeader.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=IssueHeader.HeaderInvNo,
		PackUnits=issuedetail.packunits
	from  Issueheader, issuedetail,users
	where issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode and	
			issuedetail.icode IN (:ar_icode)	and 	
			issueheader.date between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate 	and
			/*issueheader.Posted = 'Y' and */
			issueheader.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION	
	select 
		prdetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = 'PR-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), prledger.prinvcode))),
		Postdate = prledger.postdate,
		Due = null,
		date = prledger.date,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title = Case When prcatcode = 4 or prcatcode = 5 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = prledger.suppcode)	
				Else 'Opening Purchase Return'	
				End,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = prdetail.gcode),
		qtyInActual = 0,
		qtyInBonus = 0,
		QtyIn = 0,
		QtyOut= prdetail.looseqty  + prdetail.bonusqty,
		qtyOutActual=prdetail.looseqty ,
		qtyOutBonus=prdetail.bonusqty,
		batch = prdetail.batch,
		purprice=prdetail.prprice,
		discperc=prdetail.discperc,
		avgprice=prdetail.avgprice,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = prdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = prdetail.icode),
		expiry=prdetail.expiry,
		reference = '          ',
		price = prdetail.prprice,
		discount = prdetail.DiscPerc,
		UTN=isnull(prdetail.prutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=PrLedger.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=PrLedger.HeaderInvNo,
		PackUnits=prdetail.packunits
	from prledger, prdetail, users
	where  prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and	
			 prdetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 prledger.date between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate 	and
			 prledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION
	select 
		saledetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = 'SV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), saleledger.saleinvcode))),
		Postdate = saleledger.postdate,
		Due = saledetail.Due,
		date = saleledger.date,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title= (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode)	
				/*(Case 	
				When salecatcode = 1 or salecatcode = 2 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode)	
				Else 'Cash Sale'	
				End*/,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = saledetail.gcode),
		qtyInActual = 0,
		qtyInBonus = 0,
		qtyIn = 0,
		QtyOut= saledetail.looseqty+saledetail.bonusqty,
		qtyOutActual= saledetail.looseqty,
		qtyOutBonus= saledetail.bonusqty,
		batch = saledetail.batch,
		purprice=saledetail.saleprice,
		discperc=saledetail.discperc,
		avgprice=saledetail.avgprice,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = saledetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = saledetail.icode),
		expiry=saledetail.expiry,
		reference = saleledger.CustRefNo,
		price = saledetail.saleprice,
		discount = saledetail.DiscPerc,
		UTN=isnull(saledetail.saleutn,0),	
		HeaderNo=SaleLedger.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=SaleLedger.HeaderInvNo,
		PackUnits=saledetail.packunits
	from   saleledger, saledetail, users
	where  saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and	
		 saledetail.icode IN (:ar_icode)		and 	
		 saleledger.date Between  :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
		 saleledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
	union 	
	select 
		srdetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = Case  srledger.srcatcode	
				When 8 Then 'CSR-'	
				Else        'CRR-'		
			End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), srledger.srinvcode))),
		Postdate = srledger.postdate,
		Due=null,
		date = srledger.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title= Case When srcatcode = 6 or srcatcode = 7 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = srledger.custcode)
				Else 'Cash Sale Return' End,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = srdetail.gcode),
		qtyInActual=srdetail.looseqty,
		qtyInBonus=srdetail.bonusqty,
		qtyIn = srdetail.looseqty+srdetail.bonusqty,
		QtyOut= 0,
		qtyOutActual=0,
		qtyOutBonus=0,
		batch = srdetail.batch,
		purprice=srdetail.srprice,
		discperc=srdetail.discperc,
		avgprice=srdetail.newavgprice,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = srdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = srdetail.icode),
		expiry=srdetail.expiry,
		reference = '                ',
		price = srdetail.srprice,
		discount = srdetail.DiscPerc,
		UTN=isnull(srdetail.srutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=SrLedger.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=SrLedger.HeaderInvNo,
		PackUnits=srdetail.packunits
	from srledger, srdetail, users
	where  srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and	
			 srdetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 srledger.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
			 srledger.posted = 'Y' and
			 srledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
	union
	select
		duesatisfydetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = 'DS-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode))),
		Postdate = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
		Due = 'A',
		date = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title=Case	When (Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
						Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 1 
						or(Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
					Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 2 Then 
						(Select accounts.name from accounts, saleledger 
						where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode  and 
						accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode)	
				Else 'Cash Sale' /*Retail Sale Cash*/	End,
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = DueSatisfyDetail.gcode),
		qtyInActual=0,
		qtyInBonus=0,
		qtyIn = 0,
		QtyOut= DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyqty,
		qtyOutActual=DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyqty,
		qtyOutBonus=0,
		batch = DueSatisfyDetail.batch,
		purprice=0,
		discperc=0,
		avgprice=DueSatisfyDetail.avgprice,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = duesatisfydetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = duesatisfydetail.icode),
		expiry=DueSatisfyDetail.expiry,
		reference = '         ' ,
		price = (select max(saleprice) from saledetail 
					where saledetail.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
					saledetail.icode = duesatisfydetail.icode),
		discount = (select MAX(DiscPerc) from saledetail 
						where saledetail.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
						saledetail.icode = duesatisfydetail.icode),
		UTN=isnull(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyutn, 0),	
		HeaderNo=NULL,
		HeaderInvNo=NULL,
		PackUnits=DueSatisfyDetail.packunits
	from   DueSatisfyHeader, DueSatisfydetail, users
	where  DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyCode = DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyCode and	
		 DueSatisfyDetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
		 DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfydate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
		 DueSatisfyHeader.usercode = users.usercode
	union
	select 
		duedeletedetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = 'DD-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode))),
		Postdate = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
		Due = 'B',
		date = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
		salesman = users.username,
		title=case When (Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
						Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 1 
					 or(Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
						Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 2 Then
							(Select accounts.name from accounts, saleledger 
							where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode  and 
							accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode)	
				Else 'Cash Sale'
				End,
		godown = '',
		qtyInActual=0,
		qtyInBonus=0,
		qtyIn = 0,
		QtyOut= DueDeleteDetail.deletedqty,
		qtyOutActual=DueDeleteDetail.deletedqty,
		qtyOutBonus=0,
		batch = '',
		purprice=0,
		discperc=0,
		avgprice=0,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = duedeletedetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = duedeletedetail.icode),
		expiry=null,
		reference = '         ',
		price = (select MAX(saleprice) from saledetail 
					where saledetail.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
						saledetail.icode = duedeletedetail.icode),
		discount = (select MAX(DiscPerc) from saledetail 
					where saledetail.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
							saledetail.icode = duedeletedetail.icode),
		UTN=ISNULL((SELECT MAX(D.SaleUtn) FROM SaleDetail D WHERE D.RowID=DueDeletedetail.SaleRowID), 0),
		HeaderNo=NULL,
		HeaderInvNo=NULL,
		PackUnits=(select MAX(packunits) from saledetail 
					where saledetail.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
							saledetail.icode = duedeletedetail.icode)
	from   DueSatisfyHeader, DueDeletedetail, users	  	
	where  DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyCode = DueDeleteDetail.DueSatisfyCode and	
		 DueDeleteDetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
		 DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfydate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
		 DueSatisfyHeader.usercode = users.usercode
	UNION
	select 
		adjdetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = Case  adjheader.adjcatcode	
				When 1 Then 'AI-'	
				Else        'AD-'		
			End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), adjheader.adjcode))),
		Postdate = adjheader.posteddate,
		Due=null,
		date = adjheader.posteddate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title= (Select adjcategory.name from adjcategory where adjcategory.adjcatcode = adjheader.adjcatcode),
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = adjdetail.gcode),
		qtyInActual = Case  adjheader.adjcatcode When 1 THEN adjdetail.looseqty ELSE 0 END,
		qtyInBonus = 0,
		qtyIn = Case  adjheader.adjcatcode When 1 THEN adjdetail.looseqty ELSE 0 END,
		QtyOut= Case  adjheader.adjcatcode When 2 THEN adjdetail.looseqty ELSE 0 END,
		QtyOutActual = Case  adjheader.adjcatcode When 2 THEN adjdetail.looseqty ELSE 0 END,
		QtyOutBonus = 0,
		batch = adjdetail.batch,
		purprice=adjdetail.price,
		discperc=0,
		avgprice=Case  adjheader.adjcatcode	
				When 1 Then adjdetail.newavgprice
				Else adjdetail.avgprice
			End,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = adjdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = adjdetail.icode),
		expiry=adjdetail.expiry,
		reference = '                ',
		price = adjdetail.price,
		discount = 0,
		UTN=adjdetail.adjutn,	
		HeaderNo=AdjHeader.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=AdjHeader.HeaderInvNo,
		PackUnits=adjdetail.packunits
	from adjheader, adjdetail, users
	where  adjheader.adjcode = adjdetail.adjcode and
			 adjdetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 adjheader.posteddate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
			 adjheader.posted = 'Y' and
			 adjheader.usercode = users.usercode
	UNION
	select  
		receiptdetail.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = 'RC-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode))),
		Postdate = ReceiptHeader.postdate,
		Due=null,
		date = ReceiptHeader.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title= (Select department.name from department where department.deptcode = ReceiptHeader.deptcode),
		godown = (select g.name from godown g where g.gcode = ReceiptDetail.gcode),
		QtyInActual =ReceiptDetail.qty,
		QtyInBonus=0,
		qtyIn = ReceiptDetail.qty,
		QtyOut= 0,
		QtyOutActual=0,
		QtyOutBonus=0,
		batch = ReceiptDetail.batch,
		purprice=ReceiptDetail.saleprice,
		discperc=0,
		avgprice=
			Case 
				WHEN ReceiptDetail.newavgprice IS NULL THEN ReceiptDetail.avgprice
				Else ReceiptDetail.newavgprice
			End,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = receiptdetail.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = receiptdetail.icode),
		expiry=ReceiptDetail.expiry,
		reference = receiptheader.referenceno,
		price = ReceiptDetail.price,
		discount = 0,
		UTN=receiptdetail.receiptutn,	
		HeaderNo=ReceiptHeader.HeaderNo,
		HeaderInvNo=ReceiptHeader.HeaderInvNo,
		PackUnits=receiptdetail.packunits
	from ReceiptHeader, ReceiptDetail, users
	where  ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode = ReceiptDetail.ReceiptInvCode and
			 ReceiptDetail.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			 ReceiptHeader.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
			 ReceiptHeader.posted = 'Y' and
			 ReceiptHeader.salesmancode = users.usercode
	UNION
	select
		d.Icode,
		Openingbalance=0,
		OpeningDue=0,
		type = 'AV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), h.documentcode))),
		Postdate = h.postdate,
		Due = null,
		date = h.postdate,
		salesman = users.username ,
		title = 'Item Price Adjustment',
		godown = NULL,
		qtyInActual = 0,
		qtyInBonus = 0,
		qtyIn = 0,
		qtyOut= 0,
		qtyOutActual=0,
		qtyOutBonus=0,
		batch = '',
		purprice=d.newpurprice,
		discperc=0,
		avgprice=d.newavgprice,
		rate=0.00,
		itemname=(Select item.name from item where icode = d.icode),
		aliasname=(Select item.customicode from item where icode = d.icode),
		expiry=NULL,
		reference = '         ',
		price = 0,
		discount = 0,
		UTN=isnull(d.utn, 0),
		HeaderNo=NULL,
		HeaderInvNo=NULL,
		PackUnits=(SELECT i.packunits FROM Item i WHERE i.icode=d.icode)
	from  avgpriceadjheader h, avgpriceadjdetail d, users
	where h.documentcode = d.documentcode and	
			d.icode IN (:ar_icode) and 	
			h.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
			h.posted='Y' and
			h.usercode = users.usercode) T
Order By itemname, utn, date,	batch,expiry
table.sort: itemname A, utn A, date A, batch A, expiry A

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: cumulativeSum( Openingbalance + if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout))  for group 1 ) * avgprice

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: trim(string(int((cumulativeSum( Openingbalance + if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout))  for group 1 )) / if(packunits > 0, packunits, 1)))) + if(mod(int((cumulativeSum( Openingbalance + if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout))  for group 1 ))), packunits) > 0, ' : ' + trim(string(mod(int((cumulativeSum( Openingbalance + if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout))  for group 1 ))), packunits))),'')

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: trim(string(int((qtyoutactual + qtyoutbonus) / if(packunits > 0, packunits, 1)))) + if(mod(int((qtyoutactual + qtyoutbonus)), packunits) > 0, ' : ' + trim(string(mod(int((qtyoutactual + qtyoutbonus)), packunits))),'')

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: trim(string(int((qtyinactual + qtyinbonus) / if(packunits > 0, packunits, 1)))) + if(mod(int((qtyinactual + qtyinbonus)), packunits) > 0, ' : ' + trim(string(mod(int((qtyinactual + qtyinbonus)), packunits))),'')

objects.name: c_openingbalance
objects.expression: cumulativeSum( Openingbalance + if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout)) for group 1 ) - if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout))

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: trim(string(int((cumulativeSum( Openingbalance + if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout)) for group 1 ) - if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout))) / if(packunits > 0, packunits, 1)))) + if(mod((cumulativeSum( Openingbalance + if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout)) for group 1 ) - if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout))), packunits) > 0, ' : ' + trim(string(mod((cumulativeSum( Openingbalance + if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout)) for group 1 ) - if( due = 'D' or due = 'S' or due = 'X' or due = 'B', 0, (qtyin - qtyout))), packunits))),'')

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: trim(string(int(sum( qtyin for group 1) / if(packunits > 0, packunits, 1)))) + if(mod(int(sum( qtyin for group 1)), packunits) > 0, ' : ' + trim(string(mod(int(sum( qtyin for group 1)), packunits))),'')

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: trim(string(int(sum( qtyout for group 1) / if(packunits > 0, packunits, 1)))) + if(mod(int(sum( qtyout for group 1)), packunits) > 0, ' : ' + trim(string(mod(int(sum( qtyout for group 1)), packunits))),'')
